title: Human-Derived Nasal Epithelial Model and T Cell Induction Protocol
author: King, van der Valk, et al.
materials: Costar 24-well Clear Not Treated Multiple Well Plates

steps.title: Prepare airway epithelial base medium
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL HEPES (1 M), 5 mL GlutaMAX (100×) and 1 mL primocin to 500 mL advanced DMEM/F‑12, mix well and store at 4 °C for up to 1 month.

steps.title: Prepare supplement aliquots
steps.instruction: Make single‑use aliquots for one 50 mL batch of airway epithelial medium as follows:

substeps.instruction: R‑spondin: dissolve 100 µg in 100 µL sterile water, aliquot 20 µL per Eppendorf tube, store at –20 °C (≤6 months).
FGF‑7: dissolve 2 µg in 20 µL sterile water, aliquot 10 µL per tube, store at –20 °C (≤6 months).
FGF‑10: dissolve 4 µg in 40 µL sterile water, aliquot 40 µL per tube, store at –20 °C (≤6 months).
Noggin: dissolve 4 µg in 40 µL sterile water, aliquot 40 µL per tube, store at –20 °C (≤6 months).
A83‑01: dissolve 10 mg in 4.7 mL sterile DMSO; aliquot ten 4 µL portions and four ~1 mL portions per tube, store at –20 °C (≤6 months).
Y‑27632: dissolve 10 mg in 4 mL sterile DMSO; aliquot ten 20 µL portions and three ~1 mL portions per tube, store at –20 °C (≤6 months).
SB202190: dissolve 5 mg in 3 mL sterile DMSO; aliquot ten 4 µL portions and three ~1 mL portions per tube, store at –20 °C (≤6 months).
B27 supplement: dispense twelve 800 µL aliquots per tube, store at –20 °C (≤6 months).

N‑acetylcysteine (fresh each batch): add 20 mg to 1 mL airway epithelial base medium, incubate 5–10 min at 37 °C, filter through a 0.2 µm Whatman filter, then add 400 µL per batch of airway epithelial medium; store at 4 °C, check expiry.

Nicotinamide (fresh each batch): dissolve 48.8 mg in 1 mL airway epithelial base medium, filter through a 0.2 µm Whatman filter, then add 500 µL per batch of airway epithelial medium; store at 19 °C, check expiry.

steps.title: Assemble airway epithelial medium
steps.instruction: Prepare one 50 mL batch of airway epithelial medium for 3D NEM culture:

substeps.instruction: Place 38 mL airway epithelial base medium into a 50 mL tube.
Thaw on ice one aliquot each of R‑spondin, FGF‑7, FGF‑10, noggin, A83‑01, Y‑27632, SB202190 and B27 supplement.
Add the freshly prepared N‑acetylcysteine and nicotinamide solutions (from step 2) to the base medium.
Add thawed supplements: 20 µL R‑spondin, 10 µL FGF‑7, 40 µL FGF‑10, 40 µL noggin, 4 µL A83‑01, 20 µL Y‑27632, 4 µL SB202190, and 800 µL B27 supplement.
Mix well and aliquot eight 5 mL portions into 15 mL tubes (provides 500 µL per well of a 24‑well plate).
Store at –20 °C for up to 6 months or at 4 °C for up to 1 month.

steps.title: Baseline PBMC staining for flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Stain freshly isolated PBMCs (baseline) for TRM analysis on a Cytek Aurora:

substeps.instruction: Transfer 100,000 PBMCs per donor into each well of a 96‑well V‑bottom plate.
Add PBS to a total volume of 200 µL per well.
Centrifuge at 19 °C, 450 × g for 5 min.
Remove supernatant (flip plate over sink in one swift motion) and add 200 µL PBS; repeat centrifugation (19 °C, 450 × g, 5 min).
Prepare live/dead staining mix (Table 3): 0.2 µL live/dead fixable blue (1:1000) + 99.8 µL PBS = 100 µL total.
Add 100 µL live/dead mix to each well, cover with aluminum foil and incubate at 19 °C for 15 min.
Add 100 µL FACS buffer, centrifuge (19 °C, 450 × g, 5 min), discard supernatant, then add 200 µL FACS buffer and repeat centrifugation.
Prepare membrane staining mix (Table 4) totaling 100 µL per sample:
Alexa Fluor 700 anti‑human CD45 (1:800) – 0.13 µL
BV‑711 anti‑human CD3 (1:200) – 0.50 µL
BV‑510 anti‑human CD8α (1:200) – 0.50 µL
PE‑Cy7 anti‑human CD4 (1:800) – 0.13 µL
FITC anti‑human CD103 (1:20) – 5.00 µL
SB‑780 anti‑human CD69 (1:100) – 1.00 µL
BV‑650 anti‑human CXCR6 (1:100) – 1.00 µL
APC anti‑human CD62L (1:100) – 1.00 µL
Brilliant stain buffer plus (1:10) – 10.00 µL
FACS buffer – 80.74 µL (to bring total to 100 µL).
Add 100 µL membrane staining mix to each well, incubate as recommended (same conditions as live/dead step).
Wash: add 100 µL FACS buffer, centrifuge (19 °C, 450 × g, 5 min); discard supernatant, add 200 µL FACS buffer, centrifuge again, discard.
Resuspend cell pellet in 150 µL FACS buffer and transfer to 1.4 mL U‑bottom tubes.
Acquire data on Cytek Aurora (transfer tubes to 5 mL FACS tubes for acquisition).

steps.title: Harvest and stain TRMs at later time points
steps.instruction: Collect, process, and stain cells from co‑culture at days 7, 14, 21 and 28:

substeps.instruction: Remove culture plates from incubator and centrifuge at 19 °C, 450 × g for 5 min.
Optional: transfer ~150 µL supernatant to a 96‑well round‑bottom plate, seal, and store at –20 °C; discard if not needed.
Resuspend cell layer in 150 µL PBS and pass through a 40 µm cell strainer into a new V‑bottom plate (strainer retains 3D epithelial fragments).
Wash the strainer with 50 µL PBS (final volume per well ≈200 µL) to recover remaining immune cells; discard the strainer.
Centrifuge the plate at 19 °C, 450 × g for 5 min; discard supernatant and add 200 µL PBS, centrifuge again, discard.
Stain the recovered cells using the exact protocol described in steps 9f–o (live/dead staining, membrane staining, washes, resuspension, and acquisition).

steps.title: Prepare reference controls for spectral unmixing
steps.instruction: Generate single‑stained and unstained controls for Cytek Aurora compensation:

substeps.instruction: In a 96‑well V‑bottom plate, add 100,000 freshly thawed (non‑cultured) PBMCs per well.
Live/dead fixable blue control: expose 50,000 PBMCs to hot water for ≥60 s to induce death, then combine with 50,000 viable PBMCs.
Vortex anti‑mouse Ig beads and negative‑control compensation beads for ≥30 s; add one droplet of each bead type to the designated wells (see Table 5).

Prepare single‑stained controls using the volumes listed in Table 5 (e.g., 0.203 µL live/dead fixable blue, 0.134 µL AF700 α‑CD45, 0.505 µL BV‑711 α‑CD3, 0.506 µL BV‑510 α‑CD8α, 0.137 µL PE‑Cy7 α‑CD4, 5.009 µL FITC α‑CD103 on beads, 1.001 µL SB‑780 α‑CD69 on beads, 1.001 µL BV‑650 α‑CXCR6 on beads, 1.00 µL APC α‑CD62L on beads).
Stain all reference control cells/beads using the same staining sequence as steps 9f–o (live/dead, membrane cocktail, washes, resuspension).

description: This protocol provides a detailed description of the generation of a human-derived 3D nasal epithelial model (referred to as 3D NEM) and the induction of TRM-like T cells in an in vitro co-culture system. This protocol includes 6 major steps: Generation of a human-derived 3D NEM (steps 1–5); Peripheral blood mononuclear cell processing (step 6); Establishing 3D NEM and immune cell co-culture model (steps 7–8); Flow cytometric analysis of TRMs (steps 9–11); Single-cell RNA sequencing of TRMs (12–15); Functional assessment of in vitro established TRM-like cells (steps 16–17).
